title: Grateful Dead Live at Dream Bowl on 1969-02-22
lineage: EAC (secure with correct offsets) > Cool Edit (remove some pops see below) > SHN (mwkact with seektables appended)
source: SBD > MR > R > R > DAT > CDR

ai_review.summary: Crisp soundboard recording of a high‑energy 1969 Vallejo show with monster Dark Star, Eleven and Lovelight.
ai_review.review: The concert is praised as a quintessential early‑'69 psychedelic set, highlighted by soaring performances of Dark Star, Eleven (11) and Lovelight along with strong renditions of Mountains of the Moon and Doin’ That Rag. Reviewers note the tape sounds clearer than many contemporaneous releases – a crisp soundboard capture that rewards a little EQ tweaking but is otherwise very listenable.

ai_rating.rationale: All eight reviews are overwhelmingly positive (4–5 stars) and consistently praise both the musical performance and the clear soundboard source, indicating an excellent show with high‑quality audio.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the copy as crisp, clearer than other versions, and recommend only modest EQ adjustments; no major dropouts or distortion reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Early‑’69 set blends psychedelic suites from ’68 with newer Aoxomoxoa material, delivering seamless transitions and a strong second‑half jam flow.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Starts Dark Star on acoustic guitar and announces intermission; praised for his performance throughout.
